verdict.rationale: Remote's own tools support exporting data in open formats. The official CLI exports every list command to CSV and emits JSON from every command, the API lets you pull workforce and payroll data out, and payslips can be downloaded. There is no documented whole-account export or offboarding/portability path, so 'all of my data' and 'leave' are only approximated by assembling exports list by list. Missing for 10: a documented complete-account data export (including documents and contracts), an account-exit/data-portability process, and independent hands-on corroboration.
